tasks.label: check-service-ports
args: $ports=3000,8001,8002,8003,8100,5000; foreach($p in $ports){ try{$r=Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 3 -Uri "http://localhost:$p/health"; Write-Output "$p up health $($r.StatusCode)" } catch { try{$r2=Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 3 -Uri "http://localhost:$p/healthz"; Write-Output "$p up healthz $($r2.StatusCode)"} catch { Write-Output "$p down" } } }
